name: Direction-dependent Morton Order Sorting
definition: A sorting technique for sparse voxels that arranges voxels in near-to-far order for each image tile by replacing primitive z-depth with a direction-dependent Morton order, ensuring correct rendering order for all ray directions.
summary: Direction-dependent Morton Order Sorting sorts sparse voxels by remapping Octree codes based on ray sign bits to ensure correct near-to-far rendering order for arbitrary viewing angles.
